signupDiscord.title: Sign up and connect Discord
signupDiscord.summary: Create your AFC account, confirm your email and link Discord, so AFC can reach you there.

steps.details: Fill in your details and a password
steps.register: Tick the terms, then press Register
steps.code: Type the code from your email, then confirm
steps.login: Log in with your new account
steps.skip: Press Skip for now, finish setup later
steps.profile: Open the menu, then My profile
steps.discord: On Discord, check it is you, press Authorize
steps.done: Done. Your Discord is linked to AFC

teamInvite.title: Create a team and invite a teammate
teamInvite.summary: Make your team on AFC, invite a teammate by name, and they join from the invite.

steps.create: Open Teams, then press Create team
steps.details: Fill in the name, tag and bio
steps.join: Choose who can ask to join
steps.invite: Search your teammate and pick them
steps.teammate: Your teammate gets an alert on AFC
steps.accept: They open it, press View, then Accept
steps.done: Done. You are in a team together

registerTournament.title: Register your team for a tournament
registerTournament.summary: As captain, pick a tournament, choose who plays, accept the rules and you are in.

steps.find: Open Tournaments and pick the event
steps.type: Choose to register as a team
steps.members: Tick the players who will play

organizerResults.title: Enter a map's results
organizerResults.summary: As an organizer, enter each team's place and kills for a map, and the leaderboard updates.

steps.open: Press Results & Leaderboard on your event
steps.enter: Tap each team's place, add kills, Next team
steps.save: Press Submit Results when all teams are in
steps.done: Done. The leaderboard is up to date
